title: Forgetting preserves representative-normalized evaluation
statement: Fix M and ordinary and native closed structures S,W [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models], a tensor comparison t, a presentation N [def-sf-native-weil-tensor-presentation] for W.monoidal and t, native adjunction normalization hW, and Hom comparison chi with NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility. For every K,L, forgetting W.evaluation(K,L) equals t at (M.weilHom(K,L),K), followed by S.tensor applied to (chi(K,L),identity), then S.evaluation(FK,FL). All structures and comparisons are inputs: this single evaluation square asserts no existence, coherence or unit compatibility.

proof.text: Apply the fully proved native_weil_representative_uncurry. Its proof extends the projection-normalized Hom square to the K-flat source, compares the native and ordinary chain uncurrying maps on tensor summands, and pastes their localized normalization and model-forgetting squares.

proof.text: For K-flat P and K-injective I the generic proved NativeCurrying.hom_isKInjective shows that Hom(P,I) is K-injective: currying turns a map from an acyclic complex into a map from its acyclic tensor with P to I, hence a null-homotopy. Choose a K-flat representative Q of the derived internal Hom using N.localization. K-injective fullness of localization lifts its isomorphism into Q(Hom(P,I)) to a chain map φ. Apply the preceding uncurrying identity, identify inverse transposition of this map with tensoring its representative isomorphism followed by evaluation, and cancel the invertible tensor map. This proves the evaluation square on (Q(P),Q(I)).

proof.text: K-flat localization is essentially surjective, and K-injective representatives cover all target objects. Transport the representative evaluation identity along these two isomorphisms. The private generic evaluation_of_iso proof uses only naturality of the two tensor and Hom comparisons, source naturality of evaluation, and the ordinary adjunction counit naturality; it constructs no symmetry or coherence datum. This gives the stated square for every K,L.

lean.statement:
theorem native_weil_tensor_evaluation
    (M : NativeClosedHomModels k₀ l X)
    (S : CoefficientClosedStructure M.ordinaryHom)
    (W : CoefficientClosedStructure M.weilHom)
    (t : W.tensor ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ S.tensor)
    (N : NativeWeilTensorPresentation k₀ l X M S W.monoidal t)
    (hW : NativeAdjunctionNormalization (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X) N.tensor
      (fun P ↦ N.adjunction.adj P) M.weilHom M.weilRepresentatives W
      (NativeTensorKFlat k₀ l X N.tensor) N.model)
    (χ : M.weilHom ⋙ nativeForget k₀ l X ≅
      (nativeForget k₀ l X).op.prod (nativeForget k₀ l X) ⋙ M.ordinaryHom)
    (hχ : NativeHomRepresentativeCompatibility (ihomBifunctor k₀ l X)
      (ordinaryIhomBifunctor l (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
      M.weilHom M.ordinaryHom M.weilRepresentatives M.ordinaryRepresentatives
      (Endofunctor.IsoAlgebra.forget (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback k₀ l X)) χ) :
    ∀ K L, (nativeForget k₀ l X).map (W.evaluation K L) =
      t.hom.app (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L), K) ≫
        S.tensor.map
          (X := ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj (M.weilHom.obj (op K, L)),
            (nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K))
          (Y := (M.ordinaryHom.obj
            (op ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K), (nativeForget k₀ l X).obj L),
            (nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K))
          (Prod.mkHom (χ.hom.app (op K, L)) (𝟙 ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K))) ≫
          S.evaluation ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj K) ((nativeForget k₀ l X).obj L)
